name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. Changelog (last 3): 1.9.0 — /git:merge refuses proto/* naming the prototype's behaviour contract (design/prototypes/<stem>/contract.json) and /spec:plan as the next step; the harden/* refusal is gone (specs/20261007/01 D10). 1.8.0 — enter-worktree no longer runs host setup by hand: merge-back create owns it, plus a committed-spec check through --spec. 1.7.0 — Commit's escape offer says /spec:escape derives the spec and prints it for veto; the three commands' report-contract citations point at core.md instead of the retired shared.md.
